title: ICC: Japan mulls early payment to tribunal amid US sanctions

blocks.text: TOKYO – The Japanese government is considering paying its 2027 contributions to the International Criminal Court ahead of schedule, in light of US sanctions against the ICC, government sources said Friday. In October, the administration of US President Donald Trump designated the ICC for sanctions, giving a 180-day moratorium. It had already announced sanctions on ICC president Tomoko Akane in August.
